title: [BUG] non-interactive mcp add doesn't accept arguments
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [x] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
- Claude CLI version: 0.2.53 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: macOS 15.3.2 (24D81)
- Terminal:  iTerm2

## Bug Description

Using [mcp-server-fetch](https://pypi.org/project/mcp-server-fetch/) as an example (can be any python module mcp, runnable as `python -m module_name_mcp`), there is no obvious way to connect it to claude code in non-interactive way (without using the wizard).


What I tried:

1.
```
claude mcp add fetch python '-m mcp_server_fetch'
error: unknown option '-m mcp_server_fetch'
```

2.
```
claude mcp add fetch python -m mcp_server_fetch
error: unknown option '-m'
```

3.
```
claude mcp add fetch 'python -m mcp_server_fetch'
Added stdio MCP server fetch with command: python -m mcp_server_fetch  to local config

claude --mcp-debug
MCP server "fetch" Connection failed: spawn python -m mcp_server_fetch ENOENT
```

4. Using wizard works:
```
claude mcp add
1. Server Name: fetch
2. Server Scope: project
3. Server Command: python -m mcp_server_fetch

claude
> /mcp
  ⎿  MCP Server Status

     • fetch: connected
```



## Steps to Reproduce
1. `pip install mcp-server-fetch`
2. `claude mcp add --scope project fetch "python -m mcp_server_fetch"`

## Expected Behavior
added mcp server works

.mcp.json  produced:
```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fetch": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["-m",  "mcp_server_fetch"],
      "env": {}
    }
  }
}
```

## Actual Behavior
added mcp server fails to spawn

.mcp.json produced:
```
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "fetch": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "python -m mcp_server_fetch",
      "args": [],
      "env": {}
    }
  }
}
```


## Additional Context


Looks like the issue is in how `mcp add` parses arguments and could be related to #526.
author: izaitsevfb
